summary_en: PhotIQA provides 1,134 photoacoustic images reconstructed with three algorithms and rated by five experts across five image-quality dimensions. Highly characterized imaging test objects provide reference information, making the dataset directly useful for benchmarking full-reference and no-reference quality metrics for photoacoustic reconstruction.

summary_en: The paper presents a fully automated 3D photoacoustic-ultrasound system combining robotic scanning, deep-learning tissue segmentation, and quantitative biomarker extraction. A longitudinal clinical study on 43 inflammatory-arthritis finger joints demonstrates objective and reproducible assessment of vascular, oxygenation, and structural biomarkers.

summary_en: This clinical study combines B-mode ultrasound and photoacoustic oxygen-saturation imaging of the intercostal muscles to assess dyspnea severity in COPD. In 103 participants, photoacoustic oxygenation and ultrasound thickness measurements provide complementary functional and structural information, with their combination improving diagnostic performance.
